messages:
maria_sre: Heads-up: planned NAT gateway swap + ephemeral-route exercise tomorrow 03/25 02:00-04:00 UTC. Controlled drain: shift egress to replacement NATs in us-west/us-east and run a small targeted loadtest. Expect brief 5-15s latency spikes for a subset of flows.

sam_oncall: Thanks. Which pools/prefixes are in scope and are there opt-outs?

maria_sre: In-scope: edge-gpu-pools (pool-a, pool-b) and control-plane egress for metrics/artifact uploads. No tenant opt-out; we
o a staged 10% cutover by region tag.

alex_infra: Runbook and checklist posted: https://go/internal/runbooks/nat-swap-1769. Canary plan: cut to 10% -> 30% -> 100% if green. KV cache warmup check before ramps.

jamie_prod: Will this affect SLOs or public status page? Need to coordinate comms.

maria_sre: Temporary SLO adjustment: p99 gen latency relaxed to 750ms for the 2h window. Error SLO unchanged. slo-ops-bot will annotate metrics. No public status unless customer-visible degradations occur.

slo-ops-bot: (auto) SLO annotation created: nat-swap-1769129999 window 1769129999-1769130199 temp p99=750ms.

sam_oncall: Ill be oncall. Pager policy: page only for >1% 5m error spike or sustained 5m p99 >900ms. Otherwise discuss in #eng-sre.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: nat-swap/ephemeral-route-v1 -> canary @ 02:00 UTC, ramp 10% over 10m, soak 60m. CI checks passed.

alex_infra: Canary cut snippet for ops runbook:
```
kubectl -n infra patch svc nat-egress --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/metadata/annotations/canary","value":"true"}]'
sleep 30
curl -sS https://edge-checker.internal/health | jq .nat_path
```
Ensure KV cache hit ratio >90% before ramp.

jamie_prod: Ill notify CS and Solutions about the p99 window and add note to weekly ops digest.

maria_sre: Post-deploy checks: per-route latency histogram, KV cache warmup, artifact upload success rate. Quick grafana query: `sum(rate(requests[5m])) by (route)`. Rollback if any route >10% failure.

sam_oncall: If >2% 5m errors, immediate rollback. Owners: alex_infra + oncall.

alex_infra: Rollback command in runbook: `./rollback_nat.sh --id nat-swap-1769`.

maria_sre: Well run a synthetic loadtest at T+30m after canary (approx 500 conc lightweight gen reqs per region) to exercise cold KV misses and route switching. Expected ~50k tokens/min. Sam will trigger and post logs.

sam_oncall: Will monitor dashboards and post progress here.

maria_sre: Final note: will send 24h and 1h reminders. DM me if any internal integration needs opt-out (e.g., large bulk uploads).

sam_oncall: Understood. Will produce a short postmortem if anything notable occurs.

alex_infra: Confirmed no overlapping kernel/firmware windows in those AZs.

maria_sre: Maintenance executed as planned. Postmortem link will be posted in #postmortems after review. :white_check_mark:
